summary: New dellemc.openmanage modules in 10.6.0: omevv_firmware_repository_profile, omevv_firmware_repository_profile_info and omevv_vcenter_info.
questions: Which module manages OMEVV firmware repository profiles?
How do I retrieve vCenter information through OMEVV in Ansible?

answer_card.title: New OMEVV modules in 10.6.0
answer_card.answer_md:
- `omevv_firmware_repository_profile`: manage firmware repository profiles
- `omevv_firmware_repository_profile_info`: retrieve repository profile info
- `omevv_vcenter_info`: retrieve vCenter information
